# Now or Later

<!-- STEP id="envelopes" -->
Meera has ₹1,000. She can buy football shoes now, or save the money for a tennis racket later.

<!-- STEP id="time" -->
If she buys the shoes, she has the shoes but no money for the racket. If she saves, she keeps her ₹1,000 but has no new shoes for now.

**Each choice gives up the other. The racket is the opportunity cost of the shoes.**
